_about: Errors planted in the Esko sample pack (Dancing Fish Granola, US) and the check that must catch each. Used by test_sample_pack.py and the seeded-error report.

expected.finding: Total sugars (18g) more than total carbohydrate (15g)
Calories 166 vs about 330 from fat, carbs, protein
Trans fat 8g higher than saturated fat
%DV values do not match the amounts
'No Added Sugar' claim with honey and coconut sugar
'May contain' almonds and pecans that are ingredients
Weight only in grams, US needs ounces
Label ID guessed from FR pattern
Last edited / published dates and registration not provided

beyond_the_brief.finding: Honey in ingredients contradicts the vegan claim
Artwork prints carbohydrate 66g, content sheet says 15g
Artwork prints sodium 23mg, content sheet says 25mg
Ingredient lists differ (walnuts, flax, strawberries; honey 1% vs 9%)
Honey at 9% makes the ingredient order impossible
Hidden EU 'per 100g' nutrition table in the artwork file
EU reference-intake icons on a US pack
Net weight not on the principal display panel
Content-sheet nutrition columns scaled by pack size

must_not_flag.finding: Statement of identity agrees across files
